verses.text: My brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers. You know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.
We all make many mistakes. Anyone who never says anything wrong is perfect, and able to control their whole body too.
We put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, and we can turn their whole body.
Or think of ships. They are very big and are pushed by strong winds, yet a very small rudder steers them wherever the pilot wants to go.
In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts about great things. Think how a small flame can set a huge forest on fire!
The tongue is like a fire, a whole world of evil among the parts of our body. It spoils the whole person. It can set our whole life on fire, and it is set on fire by hell itself.
People can tame every kind of animal, bird, crawling creature and sea creature, and have tamed them.
But no one can tame the tongue. It is restless and evil, full of deadly poison.
With our tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse people, who are made like God.
Praise and cursing come out of the same mouth. My brothers and sisters, this should not happen.
Can fresh water and bitter water flow from the same spring?
My brothers and sisters, can a fig tree grow olives, or a grapevine grow figs? In the same way, a salty spring cannot give fresh water.
Who among you is wise and understanding? Show it by living a good life, and by doing good things with the humility that comes from wisdom.
But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, do not boast about it, and do not lie against the truth.
That kind of wisdom does not come from God above. It is earthly, it is not from the Spirit, and it comes from demons.
Where there is jealousy and selfishness, there is disorder and every kind of evil.

But the wisdom that comes from God is first of all pure. It also loves peace, and it is gentle and willing to listen. It is full of mercy and good actions. It treats everyone the same and is always honest.
Those who make peace plant seeds of peace, and they harvest a good and right life.
